title: LowVanilla

# LowVanilla — Ultimate Performance & Vanilla+

**LowVanilla** is a lightweight, performance-focused Fabric modpack built for players who want maximum frames per second (FPS) without losing the classic Minecraft feel. It acts as a drop-in upgrade for standard vanilla, focusing on technical optimization and subtle quality-of-life improvements.



![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f5f70ddfcac6d3b7109c42c010583b14c5db33f.png)

Unlike heavy modpacks that add complex tech or magic systems, LowVanilla keeps the core game unchanged. Instead, it introduces:

* **Next-Gen Rendering Engine:** Replaces standard vanilla rendering engine to massively boost FPS and reduce micro-stutters.
* **Server & Client Optimizations:** Includes internal memory leak fixes, faster world generation processing, and optimized math calculations.
* **Vanilla+ Quality of Life:** Small, non-intrusive tweaks that improve daily gameplay (such as zoom features, better inventory management, and improved tooltips) while staying 100% compatible with vanilla servers.
* **Bug Fixes:** Solves long-standing graphical and physical bugs present in the base game.

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c364c0c18921b185ccdd8f97a3837a7482fa7d24.png)

* **Perfect for Low-End PCs:** Specially tuned to bring smooth frame rates to older computers, laptops, and hardware that struggles with modern Minecraft versions.
* **Pure Gameplay:** No custom blocks, no overwhelming new mechanics, and no bloated features. It looks and plays exactly like Minecraft should—just much faster.
* **Multiplayer Ready:** Fully compatible with official realms and standard vanilla servers. Includes essential features for smooth connection and communication.

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cea47255d8109d5dde24976d686920f9dbb5e020.png)

* **Mod Loader:** Fabric
* **Recommended RAM:** 2 to 4 GB allocated in your launcher.
